description: Update a webhook endpoint. Only the supplied fields change. Set `status` to `DISABLED` to pause deliveries or `ACTIVE` to resume (resuming also clears the consecutive-failure counter). A replacement `url` must satisfy the same public-HTTPS rules as create_webhook. Idempotent. Calls the Porkbun Webhooks API (https://porkbun.com/llms/webhooks).

events.description: Replacement event subscription list (or `['*']` for all).

url.description: New HTTPS URL. Same rules as create_webhook: port 443, publicly resolvable hostname, no embedded credentials.

name: update_webhook
title: Update Webhook
